item.title: Lowspeak 1.0.1
item.description:
Lowspeak now keeps itself up to date.
- **Updates:** on the second launch, Lowspeak asks whether it may look for a new version once a day. **Check for Updates…** in the menu looks right away; the two items below it turn the daily check and automatic installs on or off. When an update is waiting, a dot appears on the ring in the menu bar. - **Coming from 1.0.0?** It has no updater yet, so install this version over it once. Your settings, keys and models stay. - **The disk image window** shows both icons with their names, on a background that stays sharp on Retina screens.
Something wrong or missing? [Report it on GitHub](https://github.com/sventmueller/lowspeak/issues/new/choose).
